title: Accountancy
description: ISC Class XI Accountancy: theory and accounting for the ISC Commerce stream.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Accountancy (subject code 858) (www.cisce.org).
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026 against the CISCE-copyrighted February 2025 Accountancy (858) syllabus document carrying the ISC Year 2027 heading and a CLASS XI section, read through its AglaSem reproduction because cisce.org returns 403 to automated fetches, with a second copy on Scribd as corroboration. Class XI prescribes Paper I Theory (3 hours, 80 marks) and Paper II Project Work (20 marks) across nine units, all nine registered below. The 11-unit structure on Oswal Publishers' 2026-27 page describes a different session and was not used.

sections.title: Accountancy
sections.description: Nine theory units from accounting fundamentals to non-trading organisations, plus project work.

chapters.title: Introduction to Accounting
chapters.blurb: Evolution of accounting, basic accounting terms, the accounting equation and the accounting cycle, with the users of accounting information and the financial, cost and management branches.

chapters.title: Journal, Ledger and Trial Balance
chapters.blurb: Journal entries, account classification and the double-entry system, ledger posting and balancing, subsidiary books including the cash book, and the preparation of a trial balance.

chapters.title: Bank Reconciliation Statement
chapters.blurb: The meaning and need for a bank reconciliation statement, and its preparation from cash-book and pass-book balances, from extracts of both, and with an amended cash book.

chapters.title: Depreciation
chapters.blurb: Meaning, need, causes and objectives of depreciation, the Straight Line and Written Down Value methods, recording depreciation in the accounts, and problems involving the purchase and sale of assets.

chapters.title: Bills of Exchange
chapters.blurb: Negotiable instruments and related terms, bills of exchange, promissory notes and cheques, with practical problems and journal and ledger entries in the books of the drawer, drawee and endorsee.

chapters.title: Accounting Concepts
chapters.blurb: GAAP concepts, the cash and accrual bases of accounting, accounting standards, and IFRS with its meaning, need and assumptions.

chapters.title: Final Accounts and Marshalling of the Balance Sheet
chapters.blurb: Capital and revenue expenditure and income, provisions and reserves, the Trading Account, Profit and Loss Account and Balance Sheet with and without adjustments, and marshalling by permanence or liquidity.

chapters.title: Rectification of Errors
chapters.blurb: The types of accounting errors and their rectification, both after the preparation of the trial balance and after the preparation of the final accounts.

chapters.title: Non-Trading Organisation
chapters.blurb: The purpose and accounting of non-trading organisations: the receipts and payments account, the income and expenditure account, and the preparation of a closing balance sheet.
